summary: Computes a packed ARGB color value from an alpha parameter (alpha = CRTFtol(a2 * 254.0 + 0.5), packed into the top byte with the low 24 bits set to 0xFFFFFF), writes that color into the offset 0x18 field of every element of the packed color-data array behind a1, then sets dirty flag bit 0x10000000 on the flag word at a1+0x14 and returns the updated flag word.

operations.description: Quantize the alpha parameter with CRTFtol(a2 * 254.0 + 0.5), shift it left 24 bits and OR with 0xFFFFFF to build the packed ARGB color value v2.
Obtain the element count v3 of the packed color-data array via PackedArrayTotalSize(a1).
Iterate i from 0 while i < v3; each iteration resolves the element pointer via PackedArrayIndexLookup(i) and writes the packed color v2 to its offset 0x18 field.
Write the packed ARGB color v2 into the offset 0x18 dword of each resolved packed-array element.
Read the flag word at a1+0x14, OR it with 0x10000000 to mark the color-alpha update, and write the result back.
